# AFA Media

> UK marketing agency for service businesses — high-converting websites, AI chatbots that capture every lead, and paid ads that target only buyers ready to book. Live in 20 days or you don't pay the setup.

AFA Media builds and operates the growth stack for UK trade and service businesses: web design, AI voice/chat assistants, and paid media, all under one roof. Founded 2025, based in Brighton.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.afamedia.co.uk/): Landing page — problem, services, pricing, book a call
- [Services](https://www.afamedia.co.uk/services): Web design, AI chatbots and paid ads — what each includes, who it's for, and how it fits together
- [Pricing](https://www.afamedia.co.uk/pricing): Monthly plans and one-time setup fees, with the founding-partner discount
- [Philosophy](https://www.afamedia.co.uk/philosophy): How we work, why we work this way, and the process from first call to live in 20 days
- [Contact](https://www.afamedia.co.uk/contact): Book a free 30-minute discovery call
